title: Class Vote

serves.summary: The child counts a class vote by dragging every vote into a picture-graph column and tapping the choice with the most votes (or the tie sign when two have the same), and plans turns on one swing so every child has a turn before anyone has a second, which shows deciding by majority vote and sharing fairly.

request.objective: Count a class vote by putting each vote in a picture graph and choose the winner, or see a tie; plan turns on a shared swing so everyone has a turn before anyone has a second. (SS001-02-E, SS001-03-E, SS001-05-H, SS002-04-D)

params.story: The class voted for a snack: apples or grapes.

problems.ask: The class voted for a snack. Find out which snack won.
problems.goal: All 7 votes are in their columns (apples 4, grapes 3) and the star under apples is tapped.

params.story: The class voted on what to play at recess: the slide, kites or the sandbox. The slide votes are drawn bigger on the carpet.

problems.goal: All 9 votes are sorted (slide 2, kites 4, sandbox 3) and the star under kites is tapped. The slide cards look biggest on the carpet but are the fewest.
